subject: Aligning MAP lanes & legal gating for Crestline pilot
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aligning MAP lanes & legal gating for Crestline pilot

Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion, I put together a lean MAP that calls out the legal/procurement gating we need to hit before Crestline can sign the order form (MSA + DPA alignment, SOC2 evidence delivery, and procurement PO timeline). I attached the working MAP (Crestline_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a copy of our current MSA for reference (Redwood_MSA_v2.1.pdf).

High-level asks:
- Can procurement confirm target PO issue date (you mentioned "end of July" as a placeholder)?
- Please confirm who will own DPA redline consolidation at Crestline (counsel or internal contracts) — our legal team (Karthik) is ready to take a single consolidated doc.
- Any mandatory procurement forms or templates we should pre-fill?

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min alignment call with procurement + legal this week to lock dependencies.
2) Redwood to deliver proposed DPA redlines (we'll flag non-starters).
3) Parallel: engineering (Markus) to confirm acceptance test milestones in MAP so procurement can tie payments to launch gates.

If that works, Karthik and I can lead the legal thread; Grace will own onboarding/acceptance items post-signature.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Crestline_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_MSA_v2.1.pdf (PDF)

From: Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Crestline Procurement <procurement@crestlinehealth.com>, Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@crestlinelegal.com>
Date: 2025-06-26T11:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning MAP lanes & legal gating for Crestline pilot

Vanessa —

Appreciate the MAP and the MSA. Quick answers from procurement side:
- Target PO date: procurement team is targeting a PO issuance window of 2025-07-27 to 2025-07-31, subject to legal signoff.
- DPA ownership: Ben Wallace (cc'd) will coordinate internal counsel and consolidate redlines. He prefers we receive Redwood's proposed DPA redlines as a single tracked PDF.
- Mandatory forms: we have a standard PO attachment (PO_Attach_Template.xlsx) and an internal privacy questionnaire — I'll share those on the call.

Two constraints to flag: Crestline requires SOC 2 Type II or equivalent evidence before production data processing; and procurement will not approve the order_form without an agreed DPA and commercial terms settled.

We can do the 30-min alignment call on 6/27 or 6/30 — Ben, what works for you?

Thanks,
Elaine
Sr. Procurement Manager
Crestline Health Systems
elaine.cho@crestlinehealth.com

Note: procurement@crestlinehealth.com will be the official intake for PO routing.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-06-27T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning MAP lanes & legal gating for Crestline pilot

Hi all —

Thanks Elaine. Vanessa, I reviewed the MSA and jotted a short list of DPA items we anticipate Crestline will push on. I'll circulate a single PDF of our proposed DPA redlines by EOD Monday (2025-06-30).

What I want to capture on the call:
- Single-point consolidation: Ben to confirm whether Crestline wants redlines inserted into their DPA or accepts our draft as the starting doc.
- SOC2 evidence delivery: we'll provide our SOC2 Type II report and recent penetration test summary; need to confirm who at Crestline is the security reviewer and the acceptable delivery mechanism (SFTP/secure link).
- Acceptance gating: Markus, please confirm the two pre-production acceptance checks (integration smoke test, data retention verification) so we can spell those milestones into the MAP and link them to payment milestones.

Proposed agenda for 6/30 10:00am PT (30 min):
1) Open: procurement timelines (Elaine) — 5 min
2) Legal consolidation approach (Ben + Karthik) — 10 min
3) Technical acceptance gates & owner mapping (Markus + Grace) — 10 min
4) Agree next steps & action owners — 5 min

Holding the 6/30 slot for now; if 6/27 is preferred we can compress.

-Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Attachments to follow: DPA_redlines_crestline_20250630.pdf (will upload to shared drive).

From: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@crestlinelegal.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Elaine Cho <elaine.cho@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: 2025-06-30T15:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning MAP lanes & legal gating for Crestline pilot

Karthik / Vanessa —

Thanks for the outline. We prefer Redwood to start from Redwood's DPA draft (easier to see proposed carve-outs). Please upload the redlines to the Google Drive folder you mentioned and share the DocuSign link for the MSA once the commercial terms are locked.

Two pragmatic asks from legal/procurement:
- Please mark any non-negotiable security clauses in the redline PDF so our team can triage quickly.
- Procurement needs the MAP to show explicit acceptance milestones tied to invoicing dates (e.g., "Pilot acceptance: completion of integration smoke test — invoice 50% at sign").

We agree to the 6/30 10:00am PT alignment call. Looking forward to the redlines by EOD.

Best,
Ben Wallace
General Counsel (Contracting Lead)
Crestline Health Systems
ben.wallace@crestlinelegal.com
